research_rationale: Read the embedded official original, held actor contexts, own terms, chain, conflicts and missing notices. Corrected the inventory using exact original-source spans. No machine search is accepted while the material current-law conflict remains unresolved. EO14173 section 3(a)(i) hereby revokes EO12898 on 2025-01-21. Its full actor context contains no delayed effectiveness for this revocation. EO12948 replaces both deadline phrases in original section 1-103(e) with March 24, 1995 wording. The hereby amendment has no special delayed effective provision; 1995-01-30 is the replacement candidate, while March 24 is a due date and not a lifecycle end. EO14008 section 220(a) replaces section 1-102. Only the beginning of the replacement is embedded; its full actor context is an overflow pointer outside the permitted one-file evidence. EO14082 section 4(b) and EO14096 section 7 amend subsequent membership/duties, but do not supply the missing 14008 context. EO14096 section 4(e) says completion of its strategic plans/assessments satisfies section 1-103. Actual completion dates are not held; elapsed report deadlines cannot establish first ends. Section 7(e) replaces original section 5-5(a), an earlier replacement candidate dated 2023-04-21 based on the hereby amendment and no delayed-effective clause in full actor text. Original research/data/public-access provisions remain independent of the first strategy/report deadlines. Sections 6-602/603 preserve other orders; 6-604/605 qualify agency scope/exemptions without automatic sunset.
